label: Ozymandias / Felina neighborhood

shared_facts.text: The empire is collapsed or collapsing; public family exposure is high.
shared_facts.text_zh: 帝国已经崩塌或正在崩塌；家庭被公开暴露的程度很高。

shared_facts.text: Multiple irreversible deaths and betrayals already sit on the ledger.
shared_facts.text_zh: 账本上已经堆着多起不可逆的死亡与背叛。

shared_facts.text: Walt can no longer honestly claim pure provider motive; pride is visible.
shared_facts.text_zh: 沃尔特再也无法诚实地声称自己只是为了养家；自尊已经露出来了。

open_tensions.text: Survivors negotiate what is left: money, safety, guilt, and who still gets a future.
open_tensions.text_zh: 幸存者在谈剩下的东西：钱、安全、愧疚，以及谁还有未来。

irreversible_costs.text: Family cover story is broken beyond simple repair.

label_zh: 第五季末：帝国、裂痕与收场
